data.one_liner: Build customizable timelines with animated, dotted, and dashed lines in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TimelineTile widget to build vertical and horizontal timelines with custom indicators, alignments, and styles. It supports animated timeline lines as well as dotted and dashed line patterns.
use_when: You need to display order tracking, step-by-step processes, or activity feeds.
You want animated timeline lines or customizable dotted/dashed styles.
avoid_when: You require complex chart visualizations rather than sequential step timelines.
strengths: Supports animated timeline lines out of the box.
Includes support for dotted and dashed lines.
Compatible with the original timeline_tile API with added features.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic examples provided in the README.
Relies on a fork of a potentially older package ecosystem.
data.minimal_example:
TimelineTile(
  alignment: TimelineAlign.manual,
  lineXY: 0.1,
  enableAfterLineAnimation: true,
  isFirst: true,
  beforeLineStyle: LineStyle(
    color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.2),
  ),
)
